court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Sakshi And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
facts_of_case: Petitioners are Hindu by religion. They have solemnized their marriage on 20.2.2020 out of their own free will. They applied for registration of their marriage before Sub Registrar, Patiyali, District Kasganj. Private respondents are interfering with marital life and liberty of the petitioners.

legal_principles.principle: The police authority concerned shall give protection to the petitioners.
legal_principles.held: The police authority concerned shall give protection to the petitioners in view of the decisions of Apex Court.
cited_cases: Gian Devi v. The Superintendent, Nari Niketan, Delhi and others, (1976) 3 SCC 234
Lata Singh v. State of U.P. and another, (2006) 5 SCC 475

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioners to show that they have real apprehension to their lives.
legal_principles.held: The petitioners have moved the police authority much before which shows that they have real apprehension to their lives.

outcome.final_order: The police authority concerned shall give protection to the petitioners. If private respondent has any grievance, he may file an application before the concerned police authority who may consider his grievance and do the needful.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for judicial separation
advising on marriage registration and its implications
assisting in a divorce case involving Hindu couples
